quantile_method: numpy.percentile linear; P99 omitted for n<100; 100 samples do not establish stable tail latency

communication.scope: PC HTTP request through existing SSH visual bridge to PS vision JSON response; application RTT, not wire-only RTT or actuator latency
communication.payload_rate_scope: 100 vision JSON replies, includes deliberate 250ms pauses; observed workload rate, not link capacity or high-bandwidth test

live_PL.scope: PS+PL input packing/cache synchronization/compute/readback, current background load; not pure kernel latency

execution_model.name: YOLOE26 · 新版参考图辅助0.10 · ROCm GPU

limitations: No motion or POST requests in this audit
No formal full-task success denominator or physical-response timestamp samples
No power measurements, clean-environment deployment benchmark, or second-device reuse trial

FPGA_build.provenance: joint-build summary plus jm2 utilization.rpt and timing_after.rpt; asset hashes match current live service

AI_quality.scope: offline retrospective known-inventory single-source-object task, 16 objects / 128 replay photos plus 3 empty photos, 64 separate reference/development photos
AI_quality.inference_source: previously recorded CPU FP32 predictions, not new live GPU FP16 inference
AI_quality.miou_definition: pooled per-material intersection/union over full 640x480 selected-target masks; average over metal/plastic/paper, background excluded from average but retained in FP/FN; misses and wrong classes included
AI_quality.f1_definition: macro average over 3 materials for selected source object; no detection counts as FN, wrong material counts as FP and FN; no poor-mask selected cases at threshold .10
AI_quality.excludes: unseen objects, current scene calibration, current GPU FP16 full pipeline, physical grasping, 26-fine-class accuracy
